# Configuration API

All models reject unknown fields and validate on assignment. Types below
describe the serialized project contract.

## `Agent`

Canonical agent configuration shared by both runtime bootstraps.

| Field | Serialized type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `name` | `string` | yes | — |
| `runtime` | `"pipecat" | "livekit"` | yes | — |
| `models` | `Models` | yes | — |
| `voice` | `Voice` | no | — |
| `persona` | `string` | yes | — |
| `flow` | `string` | yes | — |
| `tools` | `string | array[string]` | yes | — |
| `phone` | `Phone | null` | no | `null` |
| `web` | `Web` | no | — |
| `results` | `Results` | yes | — |
| `limits` | `Limits` | no | — |
| `observability` | `Observability` | no | — |
| `behavior` | `Behavior` | no | — |

## `Models`

STT, LLM, and TTS model selections plus axis-specific failover.

| Field | Serialized type | Required | Default |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `stt` | `string` | yes | — |
| `llm` | `string` | yes | — |
| `tts` | `string` | yes | — |
| `fallbacks` | `object[string, string]` | no | — |
